agnus-dei-lutheran-church.assessment: Agnus Dei is a gem for anyone seeking traditional, confessional Lutheran worship. Pastor James Shaw (M.Div., Concordia Fort Wayne) explicitly describes the church as rejecting modern religious fads in favor of 'liturgical, reverent, consistent, orthodox, and Bible-based practice.' This is exactly the kind of church that values theological precision and historic Christianity. The only caution is independent status (not formally LCMS/NALC), but the confession is solid.

score_notes.cultural: Explicitly rejects modern religious fads. Traditional and reverent.
score_notes.preaching: Liturgical, orthodox, Word and Sacrament centered.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Bible Study/Sunday School currently paused per site — held yellow.
score_notes.denominational: Site explicitly affirms 'Luther's Small Catechism and the Book of Concord to be in accordance with the Word of God'; self-identifies 'Liturgical, Traditional, Confessional.' Pastor James R. Shaw holds M.Div. from Concordia Theological Seminary (Fort Wayne, LCMS seminary). Independent confessional — no ELCA/Reconciling markers. | 2026-04-29 confirmed: Confessional Lutheran (references Luther's Small Catechism + Book of Concord). Currently meets at Saint Luke's Anglican Church (temporary) — verify whether this reflects church-plant phase or facility-share arrangement.

agnus-dei-lutheran-church.pastor_credentials: M.Div., Concordia Theological Seminary, Fort Wayne
